title: Production write-authority safe degradation for Dynamic Audit and OpenAPI inventory sync

phases.objective: Prevent repeated production startup and five-minute scheduler failures when runtime write authority is unavailable, while preserving fail-closed inventory-only boundaries.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: A transactional readiness probe rolls back, returns started=false with reason=write_authority_unavailable, emits one bounded structured warning, and does not create a scheduler interval or retry loop.
steps: Read active scheduler configuration without changing it.
Probe the scheduler ledger INSERT inside a transaction.
Rollback the probe on both success and failure paths.
Return a structured degraded startup result and stop before interval creation.
Call startup again and verify no second database connection or retry is created.
assertions: The result contains started=false, reason=write_authority_unavailable, and write_authority_unavailable=true.
The probe does not leave a durable scheduler row.
The warning contains secrets_included=false and no stack trace.
The scheduler does not repeat the denied startup on the next cadence.
The inventory verifier and dispatcher remain read-only while the trusted writer is the sole contents-write authority.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: runDynamicAuditCycle() with denied scheduler ledger INSERT
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The cycle returns ok=false and skipped=true with reason=write_authority_unavailable, stops the scheduler, and later cycles short-circuit without repeating the denied write.
steps: Acquire the advisory lock in the synthetic runtime fixture.
Classify the denied INSERT without exposing the database message as an unbounded stack trace.
Stop any active startup or interval handles.
Return the bounded cycle result and verify the next cycle is skipped.
assertions: The first denied cycle is not reported as a successful cycle.
The result contains ok=false, skipped=true, and write_authority_unavailable=true.
A second cycle does not acquire a second database connection.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Startup returns ok=true, started=false, status=write_authority_unavailable, and emits one structured degradation event while preserving non-callable inventory boundaries.
steps: Read startup configuration and confirm startup_apply is active in the fixture.
Parse and plan OpenAPI inventory without provider calls.
Rollback the transaction and return a bounded startup degradation result.
Invoke startup again and verify the warning is emitted only once.
assertions: The status is write_authority_unavailable rather than an uncaught exception.
No callable row or provider/tool export is created.
The structured warning contains write_authority_unavailable and no stack trace.

phases.objective: After separately authorized Production configuration, validate the runtime identity, bounded probe, structured startup evidence, and one-cycle readback without granting broad privileges.
Require owner-authorized grants, environment parity, deployment, and post-promotion readback; these actions are intentionally outside this source PR.
